annotations.title: Is a CIS nil return due?

description: Says whether a contractor must file a CIS nil return for a tax month (SI 2005/2045 reg 4(9A) and (9B), inserted by SI 2026/289 from 6 April 2026): due when a mainstream contractor that has paid subcontractors before pays none that month, unless it told HMRC no later than 14 days before the month started. Takes the tax year and month and yes or no answers. Returns whether a nil return is due, why, and the date it is due. Does not file anything.

mainstream_contractor.description: true for a mainstream contractor (a construction business). false for a deemed contractor, which is outside the nil return rule

paid_subcontractors_before.description: true if the contractor had paid any subcontractor before that tax month started

paid_subcontractors_in_month.description: true if any subcontractor was paid in that tax month, gross payments included

tax_month.description: The tax month, 1 to 12: 1 is 6 April to 5 May, 12 is 6 March to 5 April

tax_year.description: The tax year, by the calendar year it starts in: 2026 for 6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027

told_hmrc_no_payments_on.description: If the contractor told HMRC in advance that no payments would be made in that month, the date it did so. Leave out if not, YYYY-MM-DD

name: cis_nil_return_check
title: Is a CIS nil return due?
